name: system-one-tools
description: Workspace for System One connection, CLI, and Pi packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cartwmic/system-one-connections && npm run build --workspace @cartwmic/system-one-cli && npm run build --workspace @cartwmic/pi-system-one
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @cartwmic/system-one-connections && npm test --workspace @cartwmic/system-one-cli && npm test --workspace @cartwmic/pi-system-one
scripts.test:tui: node --test --test-name-pattern="a real Pi TUI owner journey" packages/pi-system-one/test/pi-system-one-ui.test.mjs
